description.value: You thrust a hand outward, unleashing a burst of telekinetic force that hurls a creature or object away from you. Choose one creature or unattended object you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take force damage and be pushed 10 feet directly away from you. If the push slams the target into a solid surface, it takes an additional 1d6 force damage and its movement stops.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
